selection: Prefer pilots with final-10 mean entropy >=0.1 and action0 fraction in [0.05,0.95]; among those maximize last-20 training mean, breaking ties toward smaller learning rate. If all collapse, use the smallest rate and label instability.
formal_budget_reason: Compute-limited fixed budget declared before final evaluation; at least ten 100-episode windows at a 1000-episode target. No convergence promise.
primary_checkpoint: Final-budget seed 11 checkpoint, selected before evaluation
